content: 1. Bromocriptine's metabolism is influenced by hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Its use should be avoided or replaced with an alternative drug. 2. Tipranavir increases cabergoline levels by reducing its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 3. Tipranavir elevates cabozantinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is necessary, reduce the cabozantinib dose by 40 mg/day (Cometriq) or 20 mg/day (Cabometyx). Resume the previous dose 2-3 days after discontinuing the inhibitor. 4. Carbamazepine decreases tipranavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 5. Tipranavir increases ceritinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Ceritinib also increases tipranavir levels via the same mechanism. 6. Cimetidine increases tipranavir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 7. Tipranavir elevates cisapride levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 8. Clarithromycin increases tipranavir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If renal function is impaired (ClCr 30-60 mL/min), reduce the clarithromycin dose by 50%. 9. Tipranavir increases cobicistat levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 10. Tipranavir elevates copanlisib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the copanlisib dose to 45 mg. 11. Tipranavir increases cyclosporine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 12. Tipranavir enhances dabigatran effects through pharmacodynamic synergy, increasing bleeding risk. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Tipranavir also reduces dabigatran levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter induction. 13. Tipranavir increases dabrafenib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 14. Tipranavir elevates daridorexant levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 15. Tipranavir increases darunavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 16. Tipranavir elevates dasatinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 17. Tipranavir increases diazepam levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 18. Tipranavir elevates disopyramide levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, increasing the risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 19. Tipranavir interacts with disulfiram by reducing its metabolism, increasing the risk of a disulfiram reaction due to alcohol content in tipranavir capsules. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 20. Tipranavir decreases dolutegravir levels by inducing its metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministered with strong UGT1A/CYP3A inducers, increase the dolutegravir dose to 50 mg twice daily. 21. Tipranavir increases doxepin cream levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 22. Tipranavir elevates doxorubicin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 23. Tipranavir increases liposomal doxorubicin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 24. Tipranavir elevates dronedarone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 25. Tipranavir increases duloxetine levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 26. Tipranavir reduces edoxaban levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter induction. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 27. Tipranavir elevates elbasvir/grazoprevir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 28. Tipranavir interacts with elivaldogene autotemcel, potentially reducing its effects. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Patients should avoid antiretroviral medications for at least one month before initiating stem cell mobilization therapy. 29. Tipranavir increases eluxadoline levels by reducing its metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministered with OATP1B1 inhibitors, reduce the eluxadoline dose to 75 mg twice daily. 30. Tipranavir elevates elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 31. Tipranavir increases encorafenib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is unavoidable, reduce the encorafenib dose to one-third of the original dose. 32. Tipranavir elevates entrectinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, resume the previous entrectinib dose after discontinuing the inhibitor for 3-5 elimination half-lives. 33. Enzalutamide reduces tipranavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 34. Tipranavir increases erdafitinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, monitor closely for adverse reactions and adjust the dose accordingly. 35. Tipranavir elevates ergoloid mesylates levels by reducing their metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 36. Tipranavir increases ergotamine levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 37. Tipranavir elevates erlotinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 38. Erythromycin base increases tipranavir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 39. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate increases tipranavir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 40. Erythromycin lactobionate increases tipranavir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 41. Erythromycin stearate increases tipranavir levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 42. Tipranavir interacts with ethinyl estradiol, causing significant changes in estrogen plasma levels. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced. Use a nonhormonal contraceptive method. 43. Tipranavir elevates everolimus levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 44. Tipranavir increases fedratinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the fedratinib dose to 200 mg/day. 45. Tipranavir elevates fentanyl levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 46. Tipranavir increases fentanyl intranasal levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 47. Tipranavir elevates fentanyl transdermal levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 48. Tipranavir increases fentanyl transmucosal levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is necessary, monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust the fentanyl dose as needed. 49. Tipranavir reduces fexinidazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Fexinidazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing the risk of adverse effects for CYP3A4 substrates. 50. Tipranavir elevates fluoxetine levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 51. Tipranavir increases fluticasone intranasal levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Monitor for signs of high corticosteroid concentrations, including Cushing-type symptoms. 52. Tipranavir elevates fluvoxamine levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 53. Tipranavir increases fosamprenavir levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 54. Tipranavir elevates gilteritinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, monitor for gilteritinib-related adverse effects and adjust the dosage as needed. 55. Tipranavir increases glasdegib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Monitor for increased risk of adverse effects, including QTc interval prolongation. 56. Tipranavir elevates ibrutinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor must be used short-term, interrupt ibrutinib therapy until the inhibitor is discontinued. 57. Tipranavir increases idelalisib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Monitor for idelalisib toxicity and follow dosage modification recommendations if adverse reactions occur. 58. Tipranavir elevates imatinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 59. Tipranavir increases infigratinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 60. Tipranavir elevates irinotecan levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 61. Tipranavir increases liposomal irinotecan levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 62. Tipranavir elevates itraconazole levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 63. Ivosidenib reduces tipranavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 64. Tipranavir increases ivosidenib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 65. Tipranavir elevates lapatinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 66. Tipranavir increases larotrectinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug.
